body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'Surfaces 2009') -- <Visual News> Bliss presented its 'Silver and Zinc' tech, the antibacterial protection of its kind in carpeting at Surfaces 2009 in Las Vegas from Feb. 3-5.

Healthy Home features durable and topically applied protection. The treatment is all-natural, performs for the life of the carpet and is safe for people and pets. The addition of zinc ions to the protective treatment actually improves the performance and speeds the protection process to within minutes.
